# IR-EMPOWER 2026: the programme

The second **IR-EMPOWER** workshop on infrared emissivity measurement opens on
**Monday 28 September** at the Center for Applied Energy Research (CAE) in
Würzburg. About forty participants will hear **21 talks** over two days.

- **Plenaries.** Iñigo González de Arrieta (UPV/EHU) opens with the upgraded
  emissivity setup of the group that founded the series. Benoît Rousseau
  (LTeN-CNRS) opens day two with multi-scale modelling of the spectral
  emissivity of SiC-based architectured ceramics.
- **Metrology and high temperature.** PTB, LNE, CEMHTI-CNRS, the JRC, CAE and
  UVA, including pulse heating up to 3000 °C and emissivity up to 4000 °C.
- **Applications.** Additive manufacturing (THWS, BAM, ZČU), construction
  materials (CSIC), spacecraft thermal materials (UNT) and cryogenic
  absorptivity (ISI CAS).
- **Data and comparison.** A multi-laboratory emittance comparison (INO-CNR)
  and the [EKHI open database](/data/ekhi.html) (UPV/EHU).

Monday includes a tour of the CAE laboratories and the first poster session.
Tuesday closes with a **round table** on how the community should grow, covering
intercomparisons, a newsletter, working groups and the future of the series,
followed by the **Young Speaker Award**.
